d:
Sinhasan hil uthe rajvanshon ne bhrikuti tani thi,
Burhe bharat men bhi aaee phir se nayi javani thi,
Gumi huee aazadi ki kimat sabne pahchani thi,
Dur phirangi ko karne ki sabne man men thani thi.
Chamak uthi san sattavan men, vah talvar purani thi,
Bundele harbolon ke munh hamne suni kahani thi,
Khub lari mardani vah to jhansi vali rani thi.
Kanpur ke nana ki, munhboli bahan chhabili thi,
